c. 1956, March 22
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten ori- ginal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
St. Bonaventure Monastery Blessed be God in all His designs. Capuchin Fathers 1740 Mt. Elliott Avenue Detroit 7, Michigan
Mrs. Betty Kopplin Milwaukee, Wisconsin
God bless you Mrs. Kopplin.
Many thanks for your kind favor of March 22nd just noted. We are enrolling your friends as requested in the Seraphic Mass Association, and do hope for positive results. Where there is real Faith and confidence in God -- there is no such thing as a hopeless case.
